notes.title: Japanese translation added!

Hello everybody! I'm writing a quick post to let you know that Sweetest Monster has been translated into Japanese by Ichisan!

notes.title: Spanish translation added
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of Sweetest Monster (after all these years... Wow…)

This new build fixes a couple of typos that were present in the English text, and (more importantly) adds a full Spanish translation to the VN courtesy of Aarón Acencio.

Aarón also translated my other short, dark VN, The Mermaid of Zennor, into Spanish, so you can check that out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502520]here[/url] if you're interested!

Bell can now speak in six languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese. That's very impressive. She's quite the polyglot!

I hope you enjoy the new build, and thank you very much for all of the support thus far. It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: All Ashes and Illusions released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing an announcement to let you know that my newest VN, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i], has been released on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024327/190eeea69ee5b3911ea251da9cc0f7b4e523e3cc.png[/img]

[i]Ashes[/i] is a fairly grim 'romance' story about a delusional young prince who falls obsessively in love with his childhood nursemaid, Safiya.

[i]Ashes[/i] features content some people might find discomforting, such as: a relationship with a 20 year age difference (Yuel, the protagonist and delusional young prince, is 20, while Safiya, his nursemaid and love interest, is 41), dub/noncon, written depictions of violence, coarse language, and a lot of casual misogyny.

[i]Ashes[/i] is quite a painful read, but it's one of my favourite stories I've written to date, and I'm very fond of the characters. Do consider checking it out, if you're after a VN with an older love interest, and you don't mind a hefty dose of Despair and Suffering! I'd be very interested to hear what people make of this story (and Yuel, in particular), and whether it succeeds in ousting [i]Sweetest Monster[/i] from its position of 'The Most Unpleasant ebi Story to Date'!

If you enjoyed some of my grimmer stories that tackle unsettling subject matter, such as the aforementioned [i]Sweetest Monster[/i], [i]The Mermaid of Zennor[/i], or [i]Six Days of Snow[/i], it might be worth checking out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

- ebi x

notes.title: Salome's Kiss released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I’m just writing a post to let you know that my newest visual novel, [i]Salome’s Kiss[/i], has been released on Steam.

[i]Salome[/i] is a yuri visual novel with some very gorgeous art which, on the surface, might not seem all that similar to [i]Sweetest Monster[/i]. [i]Salome[/i] is, however, one of the darker visual novels I've written, despite all the mannered prose and the cute character designs, and it has a pretty nasty ending (though perhaps it's not quite as nasty as [i]Sweetest Monster[/i]'s...)

If you enjoyed [i]Sweetest Monster[/i] for its dark and unsettling atmosphere, you might find yourself enjying [i]Salome[/i], too. They have a fair amount in common - and I want to know which story people think is the grimmest. I can't quite decide!

If nothing else, reading [i]Salome[/i] should tide you over before the release of [i]Sweetest Monster[/i]'s sequel (which I am, indeed, working on. I'm making pretty good progress on it, too, and I'm hoping to release it either late this year or early next).

If you're interested, you can pick [i]Salome[/i] up here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1779960/Salomes_Kiss/

And I hope you enjoy it, if you do decide to check it out!

- ebi x

notes.title: German Translation
notes.content:
A new build of Sweetest Monster has been uploaded to Steam, which includes a full German translation, a couple of typo fixes in the English script, and some minor edits to the UI to make it look slicker.

Thank you to everybody for all your support. It is because of you I’ve been able to translate this visual novel into so many languages, and it’s most appreciated!

notes.title: French translation
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

I recently uploaded a new build of Sweetest Monster to Steam, which includes a full French translation of the story by [url=https://twitter.com/herclinze]Herclinze[/url]! 
It's kind of amazing that this VN is now available in four different languages... I never expected this would happen, but I'm very thankful!

This build also contains a small edit to the Russian translation, to correct a minor bug.

If this update does anything strange to the game, such as breaking achievements, please let me know. It would be appreciated!
If you find any typos, errors, or anything of the sort, feel free to point those out, too!

Thank you,

notes.title: Rituals in the Dark Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

My newest VN, Rituals in the Dark, has been released! It's a short yuri VN with some vaguely spooky themes, with art by the same artist who worked on Sweetest Monster!
Rituals is nowhere near as dark as SM is, and the have very different stories, but they're very similar from a visual standpoint. If you liked the artwork in SM, you might like the visual design of Rituals, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118880/Rituals_in_the_Dark/

I hope you enjoy it, if you choose to pick it up. Thank you!

- ebi

notes.title: The Language of Love Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I thought I'd let you know I've released my newest VN, The Language of Love! It's a kinetic BxG romance story, and it's very different to Sweetest Monster. LoL is more of a 'standard' romance story, and it doesn't include any horror elements...
But, if you enjoyed the writing of Sweetest Monster, you might be interested in LoL all the the same.
LoL also has a few fanservice scenes and an 18+ patch that can be downloaded through Steam, if that's a dealbreaker for anybody haha
If you have any spare time, please consider checking it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027620/The_Language_of_Love/

Thank you!

- ebi x

notes.title: New VN on Steam
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Just letting you know, I've released a new VN on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/628460/Lily_of_the_Valley/

Lily of the Valley is a short, gloomy story about a man who meets a mysterious young girl in the Welsh countryside. Its main themes are: the importance of family, the inevitability of death, and the deliciousness of doughnuts.

Given it's a short VN, it can be purchased for $2.99.

I think Sweetest Monster and Lily both share a lot of similar themes, and I consider the two stories to be set in the same universe. Tonally, they're a little different (Lily doesn't have any fanservice elements, and is less unpleasant), but I thought some people might be interested.

- ebi x
